shots.focal_element: Large white 'AI Workspace' headline above a slightly tilted app window (Home inbox) rising from the bottom of frame on the grainy magenta-orange-blue gradient
shots.transition_other: window rises from below with heavy motion blur while the headline fades/sharpens in; the hand-off from the s022 logo card is not visible on the sheet
shots.typography: Large bold geometric sans-serif headline in white, title case, normal-to-tight tracking, centred above the window; it fades in from a soft low-opacity state. App UI text inside the window is native product type and is not enumerated.
shots.what_happens: A blurred, perspective-tilted app window slides up from the bottom and flattens as the 'AI Workspace' title resolves above it, landing on 'every interaction faster' (w243-w245) and completing the triple started in s021-s022.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a grainy gradient, tween a window screenshot from y=+60% with rotateX ~20deg and 20px motion blur to y=+30% flat and sharp over ~0.6s, while fading a bold white two-word headline from 30% to 100% opacity centred above it.

shots.focal_element: The app window, which whips horizontally with extreme motion blur from the Home inbox to a zoomed-in 'Work' workspace view
shots.transition_other: continuation of the s023 camera move (the headline lifts out of the top of frame as the window rises); no visible cut
shots.typography: The 'AI Workspace' headline from s023 (bold white sans, title case) exits off the top; the rest is native UI text, unreadable through the blur.
shots.what_happens: The window rises and pushes the headline out, then a horizontal whip with heavy motion blur (near SFX x010) swaps to a zoomed-in top-left corner of a different workspace ('Work') as the VO asks 'Ready to make the switch?' (w246-w250).
shots.build_rebuild: Translate the window up while the headline exits, then do a ~0.4s horizontal whip with strong directional blur that lands on a 2x crop of the next screenshot's top-left corner with the cursor on the workspace switcher.

shots.composition_other: cropped top-left corner of the app window (workspace menu) with the gradient visible along the top and left edges
shots.focal_element: Open 'Work' workspace menu with the 'Settings' button the cursor is heading for
shots.typography: Native UI only: workspace name in semibold sans, sentence case; menu items regular weight; section labels ('Manage', 'Switch Workspaces') small grey; normal tracking. Font guess (low confidence): Inter-like UI sans.
shots.what_happens: Zoomed into the top-left of the window, the cursor has opened the 'Work' workspace dropdown, moves down to 'Settings' and clicks as the VO says 'Admins and owners can' (w251-w254); the view then cuts to the 'All settings' sidebar (General highlighted) at the end of the shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Show a ~2.5x crop anchored on the window's top-left corner with an open dropdown, animate the cursor from the switcher to the 'Settings' button with a hover/press state, then swap to the settings screenshot on click.

shots.focal_element: Full app window on the gradient showing the 'Workspace Settings' page, with the 'ClickUp 4.0 NEW' section and 'Workspace version' dropdown in the middle
shots.typography: Native UI only: page title in semibold sans, sentence/title case; section headers medium weight; small pill badges ('NEW', 'Enterprise') in tinted uppercase/sentence case; settings list in small regular sans. Smaller settings rows are not enumerated.
shots.what_happens: The camera pulls back to the full rounded window centred on the gradient; the cursor leaves the settings sidebar and travels to the 'Workspace version' dropdown as the VO says 'now return on ClickUp 4.0' (w255-w260).
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the window from ~2.5x back to ~70% width centred on the gradient over ~0.4s with motion blur, then glide the cursor from the sidebar to the dropdown control in the centre column.

shots.focal_element: 'Workspace version' dropdown opened, listing 'Everyone uses 3.0' and 'Everyone uses 4.0'
on_screen_text: After refreshing, everyone's Workspace will switch to the version you activate.
shots.typography: Native UI only at large zoom: bold sans page title, medium-weight section headers, regular body and grey helper text, sentence case, normal tracking; small tinted pill badges.
shots.what_happens: Pushed in so the settings column fills a white frame, the cursor clicks the 'Everyone uses 4.0' dropdown, which opens to show the 3.0 / 4.0 options and stays open, under 'in your workspace settings' (w261-w264).
shots.build_rebuild: Crop the settings page at ~2x so the column fills the frame, click the select control and reveal a shadowed two-item menu below it with a quick fade/scale-in, holding for ~1.5s.

shots.focal_element: ClickUp logomark and wordmark centred on white
shots.typography: Brand wordmark: heavy rounded geometric sans, title case 'ClickUp', tight tracking, near-black; no other type.
shots.what_happens: On a clean white frame the gradient logomark appears alone, then the wordmark is revealed left to right behind a thin blue swoosh stroke (near SFX x011) and the lockup settles and holds to the end while the VO says 'Welcome to ClickUp 4.0.' (w265-w269).
shots.build_rebuild: Centre the logomark on white, then mask-reveal the wordmark left to right while a thin gradient stroke sweeps across it over ~0.5s, ease the full lockup into its final centred position and hold for ~3s.

hook.text: Your workspace is about to change forever.

cta.text: Ready to make the switch? Admins and owners can now return on ClickUp 4.0 in your workspace settings.

summary.tone: Confident, upbeat product-launch tone: brisk feature-by-feature walkthrough with a friendly, slightly playful voice (caveman GIF in s002, meme image in s018) that turns into a polished brand 'craft' montage and a practical how-to-switch CTA.

signature_moments.description: The opening line is delivered inside the product: a chat post reads 'Your Workspace is about to change forever.' and the threaded reply matches the VO word for word (w0-w25), while the camera zooms through into the post.
signature_moments.why_premium: The product itself carries the hook, so the very first seconds are already a demo and avoid a generic title card; text and VO are tightly synced.

signature_moments.description: A craft montage: a perspective-tilted UI plane racks focus, feature cards fly through with motion blur, a 'pixel precision' callout points at a window corner, cards stack into a ClickUp logo card, and an 'AI Workspace' title resolves over a rising window under 'Every pixel refined, every workflow smoother, every interaction faster' (w237-w245).
signature_moments.why_premium: It shifts register from screen recording to designed 3D/motion graphics exactly when the script claims craft, so the visuals prove the claim instead of just stating it.

signature_moments.description: A consistent camera system: the rounded, shadowed app window floats on one grainy gradient and the camera zooms through into ~2-2.5x close-ups on the exact control being used, then pulls back out.
signature_moments.why_premium: One repeatable framing grammar keeps a dense UI legible at video scale and makes 20+ shots feel like one continuous, authored camera move.

hook.evidence: Bold-claim line delivered diegetically as an in-app post with an immediate zoom-through and a humorous GIF; strong and on-brand, though it states no concrete pain or benefit until w11-w25.

clarity.evidence: Each feature gets a named VO line and a matching cursor-driven demo (hierarchy, Planner, Teams Hub, subfolders, task types), but almost no on-screen labels name the features and s012 packs Teams Hub plus a whip to subfolders into one 16.6s shot, so viewers must follow fast UI.

ui_showcase.evidence: Real product UI shown at legible zoom with scripted cursor paths, a spotlight dim on the Teams Hub tab bar, glowing outlines on custom-field groups and an actual settings walkthrough for the switch.

motion_polish.evidence: Smooth zoom-through push-ins with motion blur, whips between screens, a 3D tilted-plane and card-stack montage and a stroke-swept logo reveal; the zoom-through device is repeated many times and a few transitions are long blurred holds rather than designed moves.

sound_design.evidence: Judged from anchors, not listening: music at about 126 BPM under the VO, integrated loudness -21.23 LUFS (quiet for online delivery), and only 11 SFX candidates, mostly reverse swooshes marking section changes (x001 10.0s, x002 23.0s, x003 38.7s, x004 55.8s, x005 70.5s), a denser but low-confidence cluster in the craft montage (x006-x010) and a swoosh on the logo (x011). Competent and sparse rather than distinctive.

vo_script_quality.evidence: Tight, benefit-led lines ('so work flows without the context switching' w55-w61, 'know your team's true capacity at a glance' w142-w149) and a rhythmic triple close (w237-w245); some list-like stretches and a functional rather than emotional CTA.

brand_consistency.evidence: One grainy magenta-orange-blue gradient and rounded shadowed window treatment throughout, gradient accents echoing the logomark, and a clean resolve to the ClickUp lockup.

works_muted.evidence: Only the opening post and reply, 'pixel precision', 'AI Workspace' and the logo carry the message on screen; feature names and benefits live in the VO, so muted viewers see competent UI clicks without knowing why they matter. The CTA steps (settings, version dropdown) are partly self-explanatory.

overall.evidence: A premium-feeling launch overview: real UI shown beautifully with a consistent camera system and a designed craft montage that backs up the script; held back by heavy VO dependence, sparse sound design and a long, dense middle section.

localization_friendliness.notes: Very few added overlays (s021 'pixel precision', s023/s024 'AI Workspace', the logo), so re-voicing plus a couple of replaced titles is cheap; but the hook text in s001-s003 is baked into the English product UI and mirrors the VO, all demo UI is English, and the story depends on the VO.
